name: dreamyPastel
title: Dreamy Pastel
description: Ethereal lavender sky, soft blush rose, diffuse powder blue bokeh, dreamy floating deceleration, and angelic luminous glow.
do: Wrap highlights with soft, dreamy atmospheric diffusion and haze
Let floating camera movement drift gracefully through pastel layers
Use elegant serif titles with airy letter tracking and gentle fade-ins
dont: Do not use aggressive high-velocity camera whips or abrupt snaps
Avoid harsh industrial black and neon yellow hazard contrasts
Never apply hard jagged edges without optical softness
